The '''Tapani Home Defense Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] existing since the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Octavian Grant]] served in it with distinction before his departure to fight in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
